Codex review: blocked before merge. ## What this changes This PR transfers changed session-entry fields instead of complete warm snapshots while preserving publication and mutable return values. **Example:** Rename a warm session from “warm” to “changed” while retaining a 60 KiB skills snapshot. - **Before:** The patch reply transfers unchanged snapshot contents. - **After:** The reply transfers changed fields and removals, then reconstructs the complete entry from revision-validated resident facts. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The change has relevant production-path measurements and focused state-contract coverage, but adverse runtime signals leave performance acceptance unresolved. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): The PR records separate real dev Gateways using WebSocket metadata churn and concurrent mock-provider turns, with completed operations and reduced patch-transfer bytes; focused native-worker measurements include reconstruction and mutable-result copying, without establishing a Gateway-wide speedup. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Repeated metadata updates allocate and decode unchanged session snapshots on the Gateway thread. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction targets measured redundant work without new configuration or storage contracts; runtime acceptance is explicitly deferred in the PR. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 1 item remains** Keep open: this PR provides a distinct allocation reduction absent from current main, with no definite introduced defect found; performance acceptance remains explicitly pending. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958` ## Before merge - [ ] **Resolve merge risk** - Before merge, the author should resolve the reported adverse Gateway GC and latency signals with the pending controlled comparisons, or explicitly accept the measured tradeoff. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Session metadata callers submit patches to the agent database worker, which commits stored entries and returns publication facts for Gateway replicas, observers, and callers. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Metadata caller] --> B[Existing patch owner] B --> C[Agent database worker] C --> D[Session database] C --> E[Delta or complete candidate] E --> F[Gateway reconstruction] F --> G[Commit admission and publication] G --> H[Replica and mutable caller result] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the existing revision-validated replica and publication owners, and land the delta optimization only after its performance tradeoff is resolved. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source transfers complete publication entries on changed patches, and the PR reports a baseline-failing wire-size regression; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The approach removes redundant transport through existing owners while preserving cold and superseded-preimage behavior; its net runtime benefit remains subject to performance acceptance. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [274a86d02feb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/274a86d02febe855ca2aeea71f44000531689e0a). ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Complete the controlled comparison (recommended)** The author should use the pending comparison to determine whether the allocation savings preserve Gateway GC and latency. 2. **Explicitly accept the tradeoff** The feature owner may accept the measured runtime cost if the allocation benefit warrants it. 3. **Pause the optimization** Retain complete replies if controlled measurements do not justify the added reconstruction work. ### Provenance checked - `Worker patch execution and publication` keeps the original intent (d6929f854d2e9d58b1482aad072cc5da7f4bafcf: Move prepared metadata patches into the existing worker while retaining FIFO, transaction predicates, live authority, native receipts, and publication.) - `Full publication facts and omitted caller results` keeps the original intent (1aac796623fae26eb079bb6a0f33b920fef061a3: Omit unused caller results while keeping entry-returning APIs, observers, publication facts, and final authority intact, as documented in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176601.) - `Sealed publication source` keeps the original intent (8656a687160dbfdd95fd16ae1682e033747d2a07: Reuse committed facts through the existing replica while preserving invalidation and caller-owned authorization; sealing must also cover an emptied full-entry map whose entry is reconstructed by the host.) - `Gateway measurement workload` keeps the original intent (9fe8d3e95e0da14efee8e1f1146073fb0d34f9e7: Separate untraced timing from allocation instrumentation and retain representative mixed workload diagnostics; the added polling counts and whole-soak CPU support this comparison.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned change:** The introduced diff adds revision-validated delta transfer, reconstruction before admission, mutable-container copying, one focused regression, and measurement support. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.ts:110`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958/src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.ts#L110), [f9641d491299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958)) - **Current main still transfers full publication entries:** Current main constructs the complete patch candidate without entryDelta; the central optimization remains distinct work. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.worker.ts:288`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/274a86d02febe855ca2aeea71f44000531689e0a/src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.worker.ts#L288), [274a86d02feb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/274a86d02febe855ca2aeea71f44000531689e0a)) - **Existing ownership and freshness contract:** Replica receipts already use session lookup keys and dependent session-ID scopes; this PR uses those same scopes and retains full replies when the worker revision differs. ([`src/config/sessions/session-actor-replica-receipts.ts:45`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958/src/config/sessions/session-actor-replica-receipts.ts#L45), [f9641d491299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958)) - **Behavioral regression coverage:** The added production-owner test checks bounded transfer, removed fields, independently mutable nested results, and preservation of a newer persisted snapshot. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.operations.test.ts:225`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958/src/config/sessions/session-entry-patch.operations.test.ts#L225), [f9641d491299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958)) - **Measured benefit and explicit acceptance pause:** The full PR body reports 12.2% and 24.3% lower owner allocation and 86.0% fewer transferred bytes per patch, but adverse Gateway GC and latency signals; it explicitly leaves acceptance pending controlled comparisons. ([f9641d491299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9641d4912992ff8070affaec5f4c8d30ff83958)) - **Inherited CI failure:** The failed tooling check expects a missing dynamic Doctor-import edge. https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183272 records the identical failure on the pinned merge base and supplies its merged repair; this PR does not change that importer or modeler. ([`config/knip-dynamic-consumers.mjs:35`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/418c2ba3b39200ba38e14da0c28b2e1e2cb1abe0/config/knip-dynamic-consumers.mjs#L35), [418c2ba3b392](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/418c2ba3b39200ba38e14da0c28b2e1e2cb1abe0)) ### PR surface Source +131, Tests +58, Other +38. Total +227 across 6 files. Added test files: 0.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 3 | 210 | 79 | +131 | | Tests | 1 | 58 | 0 | +58 | | Docs | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Other | 2 | 55 | 17 | +38 | | **Total** | **6** | **323** | **96** | **+227** |
### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test growth** | Runtime production +210/−79, net +131; tests +58/−0. | Growth implements revision validation, publication reconstruction, and mutable-result isolation using existing owners; the regression protects distinct transfer and state contracts. | ### Labels Label changes: - add `P2`: A useful internal allocation improvement with no established urgent user-facing failure. - add `merge-risk: 🚨 other`: Runtime performance remains unresolved: the supplied Gateway measurements show adverse GC and latency signals despite lower patch allocation. - add `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - add `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Overall readiness is 🦐 gold shrimp; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🦐 gold shrimp. Label justifications: - `P2`: A useful internal allocation improvement with no established urgent user-facing failure. - `merge-risk: 🚨 other`: Runtime performance remains unresolved: the supplied Gateway measurements show adverse GC and latency signals despite lower patch allocation. - `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Overall readiness is 🦐 gold shrimp; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🦐 gold shrimp. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Resolve the pending controlled Gateway comparison and record whether the allocation savings justify the GC and latency tradeoff. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired.
